GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (9 Sep 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN-1189)
APO 500
9 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of Internees.
1. The following persons incarcerated in Sugamo Prison were released unconditionally 9 September 1946:
KAMISAGO Masashichi (Major General)
NAKAMURA Aketo (Lieutenant General)
ONO Koichi (Major General)
TAKAJI Shigeto (Major General)
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will therefore make the proper notations in its records.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
